flags.why: In this construction, ngất ngư should follow cười.
flags.fix: Cả nhà cười ngất ngư vì câu chuyện của bố.

flags.why: This denotes a historical boat serving pleasure seekers, rather than an ordinary recreational boat ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-l%C3%B5ng)).
flags.fix: small boat formerly used for courtesan entertainment

flags.why: The boat sense is obsolete, so rare alone does not adequately label it ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-l%C3%B5ng)).
The example incorrectly uses lõng for a modern sightseeing boat ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-l%C3%B5ng)).
flags.fix: Ông ấy xuống lõng nghe hát. = He boarded the courtesan boat to listen to singing.

flags.why: Bống remains ordinary fish vocabulary and is not archaic or confined to literature ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BB%91ng)).
Cách tân has a formal register that the entry leaves unmarked ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/cach-tan-exuKiwUMstFNZ.html)).
